SESSION 129 (2026-09-03) -- WARRANT#387-407. Four subagents + headless Strategy Tester.

BOARD: automated MET 17 -> 22. NOT MET 7 -> 16. Coverage 30 -> 42 of 46.
UNAUTOMATED list EMPTY for the first time in the campaign.
Earned: C2.2, C3.2, C6.1, C6.4, C8.2.

NOT MET rose because eleven criteria that had NO checker now have one and ten fail. They
were never passing -- they were unmeasured. The board getting worse is the board getting true.

THE HEADLINE -- it armed live on four trades and said it had cleared every gate.
From the tester log, in order:
  ghost - only 1 qualifying trades in OOS window - minimum 20
  phase 6 PRI result | WR withheld (n 4 < 1309) | armed at best
  P6 - Choppy - OOS 100.0% calib 44.9% - 1t - clean
  ARMED - 100.0% WR - PF 2.00 - E[R] +2.50R - 4/6 gates
  >> Trading live, at full size. Cleared every gate with real margin. No action needed.
That sentence keyed only on breakeven -- never on the gates it PRINTS one line above, never
on the sample. Fixed (WARRANT#391). None of it was hidden; it became legible the moment one
number was replaced by the reason it could not be trusted.

C3.2 MET -- after I retracted it once. RATE_TOKEN only ever matched ONE WORD ORDER:
"WR %.1f%%" yes, "%.1f%% WR" no. That hid 38 sites for the whole campaign -- all of P3B's
weight-search trace, day-complete, CATREC diagnoses. Then LB_Add turned out not to be on the
emitter list either, hiding six more INCLUDING THE ARMED AND STAND DOWN BANNERS. Real site
count is 176; the campaign has been auditing 118-132. Final: 173 floor-enforced, 2
specification, 1 derived threshold, 0 unguarded. Independently re-derived by an adversarial
verifier that does not use the audit's own classification.

C1.1 ROOT CAUSE IS NOT THE MUTATIONS. It is a rescale only the live scorer applies:
totalScore * (88.0/_refMax) = 88/169 = 0.5207. Over 49,999 bars: as shipped the gap is 18.36;
making the twin apply all 45 mutations makes it WORSE (18.99); making it apply the RESCALE
cuts it to 4.31, minus 77%. THIS IS THE TRADE-SUPPRESSION MECHANISM -- calibration fits
thresholds on one scale, live applies them to half-scale output (26.5% vs 1.3% of bars
qualify). The build's own portal audit has been LOGGING that ratio for a month without naming
it. Fix = extract the tail behind a flag defaulting OFF, ~25 lines -- but it INVALIDATES EVERY
STORED THRESHOLD, wrong by ~1.9x TOWARD TRADING MORE. Scoped and costed. NOT SHIPPED -- yours.

DEAD LOGIC FIXED: g_DailyWins / g_DailyLosses / g_DailyProfit are declared, reset daily, read
at 16 sites, and incremented NOWHERE in 65,000 lines. So the live-adaptive threshold block
(recentTrades < 10) HAS NEVER RUN, and the two-bad-days slingshot can never fire. Wired at
RecordTradeResult -- same site and shape as WARRANT#221's Asian counters.

TWO CRITERIA WERE PASSING ON HALF THEIR OWN RULE. C1.3 claimed six shared scorers and measured
five (no pattern column, ever) -- added to the EA and consumed: pattern_mismatch 0 over 197
bars. C6.1 counted unresolved bars as labelled; the resolved column was already loaded into a
variable and never read.

WARRANT#394 -- does the filter select? With null and planted controls that must both pass:
at NO threshold does selection differ from declining by more than chance. Every bucket has
negative expectancy. The filter is not selecting, for or against.

THE TESTER IS THE WAY PAST THE RUN GATE -- offline, places no orders. C2.2 MET (took three
fixes: globbed only the live dir; then picked the newest FILE not RUN and returned MET on the
OLDEST run in an append-only log, which EA_BUILD_ID cannot detect; then judged tester logs by
their SIMULATED timestamps). C6.4 MET on three calibrations over advancing windows, recorded
with its weakness stated -- the calibration is stochastic and a 3-point rank correlation is
weak evidence. C6.3 still NOT MET: the EA cannot compute type I/II error rates.

TO REPORT PLAINLY: the first tester launch also loaded the default profile, so a LIVE EA
instance ran for about a minute. It placed NO orders (checked), reached Phase 1, died with the
terminal. Later launches use an empty notrade profile.

THE VERIFIER EARNED ITS KEEP FIVE TIMES -- four bugs of mine (argument swapped to WRStr, format
left as %f: compiles clean, prints garbage) and one pre-existing: the APEX heartbeat fed ONE
argument list to a ternary between TWO different format strings, passing a double into a %s
slot on every heartbeat outside competence [40,60), for as long as it has existed.

C8.5 STAYS NOT MET DELIBERATELY. Its held-bar half is prose-regex matched against a house style
later sessions stopped using. I rewired the half that could be corroborated against the board,
and did NOT tune the regexes to my own wording -- a checker rewritten to recognise its author's
phrasing is the definition of opening a gate for convenience, which is what that criterion forbids.

BUILD: WARRANT#387-407, eleven compiles each verified four ways, two reverted whole, final
0 errors 0 warnings, deployed byte-identical, MD5-verified. Terminal not running. Live trading
behaviour unchanged except where provably broken.

OPEN AND WAITING ON YOU: C1.1 (the rescale -- changes live scoring and every stored threshold),
C3.1 (114 of 176 sites lack net b; 27 of them MUST NOT be "fixed"), C6.3, C4, plus eleven newly
measured criteria that each now have a named reason.

8 files attached: full report, final board, ledger entry, the ARMED-on-4-trades log excerpt,
the C3.2 audit, the C1.1 root-cause document, the selection test, the learning trend.

Pausing here.
